description: Angular component for managing device profiles in the Thingsboard UI, including form building, handling profile and transport type changes, and updating form data.

classes.name: DeviceProfileComponent
classes.description: Angular component for creating and editing device profiles, extending EntityComponent, with form handling and profile type management.

methods.name: hideDelete
methods.description: Determines if the delete option should be hidden based on table configuration.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Constructs the reactive form for device profile data, setting up value change subscriptions.

methods.name: checkIsNewDeviceProfile
methods.description: Initializes form values for new device profiles.

methods.name: deviceProfileTypeChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to device profile type, updating profile data accordingly.

methods.name: deviceProfileTransportTypeChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to transport type, updating profile data accordingly.

methods.name: updateForm
methods.description: Populates the form with existing device profile data.

methods.name: prepareFormValue
methods.description: Prepares and transforms form data before submission.

methods.name: onDeviceProfileIdCopied
methods.description: Dispatches notification when device profile ID is copied.
